To deploy a Telegram bot, run it as a persistent process rather than a serverless function.

Use long polling first, since it needs no public URL and no certificate. Switch to webhooks when you need instant delivery at higher volume, which requires a public HTTPS endpoint with a valid cert. Keep the token in an environment variable and state in a real database.

Deploy a Telegram Bot: Polling, Webhooks and Staying Online 24/7

Quick thread 🧵
To deploy a Telegram bot, run it as a persistent process rather than a serverless function.
Use long polling first, since it needs no public URL and no certificate.
Switch to webhooks when you need instant delivery at higher volume, which requires a public HTTPS endpoint with a valid cert.
Keep the token in an environment variable and state in a real database.
